turns.agent_input: An insurer's auto-claim severity jumps 9% after a new repair-network contract. observations: new network concentrated in hail region
not_observed: No additional facts beyond the prompt should be assumed.
discriminating_evidence: compare matched repair types/regions and pre/post network prices; separate hail mix from unit cost
acceptable_interventions: adjust for claim mix before termination
scoring_notes: Region and claim-mix confounding makes raw severity unsuitable for causal attribution.
